tests: R1, R2: every vocabulary and bound is exported with its value unchanged from before the move (R13's none_exists aside)
R2: LAW_LEVELS is jurisdictions' own binding (its R31), never a copy; lawProposalLabel is record-grammar's proposalLabel for governing_laws
R2: kindReadsAsWritten reads exactly ACTION_KINDS; isQuoteEntry and quoteValue answer as before the move
R1: riskTierState reads 1, 2, 3 and undetermined (absent, null, the word) and nothing else; RISK_TIERS holds each tier's words
R1, R11: actionKinds(view) answers the product's kinds, then the view's action_kinds once each, in order; under the test profile it adds that profile's kinds
R3: the records law: C-2.10's law arm and the one site minting RECORDS_LAW_REFUSED (C-73.6), as before the move, over every document
R3 by hand: law only on a records_request, at most RECORDS_LAW_MAX characters, absent reads undetermined; the refusal carries C-73.6's row and its findings; a legacy kind reads as written
R4: quoteFindings answers, for every entry of every ledger, what it answered before the move
R4 by hand: each refusal first found (C-72.1–C-72.5); a waiver is a revision to zero and both stand; negative control: a clean quote answers nothing
R5: lifecycleFindings answers, for every entry of every ledger, what it answered before the move
R5 by hand: each refusal (C-94.1–C-94.9); DUE_CITE_NOT_GOVERNING is not asked here; no due date is computed; negative control: a clean chain answers nothing
R6: actionBasisFindings and correspondenceFindings answer, for every document, what they answered before the move

R6 by hand (DEC-13): a request_for_comment names an inquiry it advances and states a window as a clock entry; a rests_on leg or an advances leg onto a non-inquiry is not a disclosure; the window's length is never compared; another kind is not asked
R6 (T51 fix round 10, B5): the leg repairs (grammar.mjs:146, :168) name no field and no plane term (kind: rests_on, kind: advances, action_basis), and the leg refusals still say what is wrong
R6 (T51 fix round 10, B6): every finding and repair of the leg, correspondence, quote and lifecycle arms is in plain words: none names a field or a code

R6 (T51 fix round 10, N7): a request_for_comment with no advanced question is refused in plain words: its finding and its repair name no plane term (ZERO, action_basis, legs of kind), and it still says why
R30 (T51 fix round 10; K5297): over the corpus, no finding, repair or translation a person reads names a field, a stored code or a DEC- id; the basis-leg label is a plain name
R7: checkActionExtension reports, for every document under every instance kind set, the findings it reported before the move
R7 by hand: a missing counterparty and a pending clock entry past its date are reported (C-2.10, C-11.1); any other document gets nothing; it answers nothing; nowMs defaults to the clock
R8: every reader and arm actions calls answers, for every document and scalar, what actions' copy answered before the move
R8 by hand: governingLawsOf's undetermined sentence names no law, even for a kind that named one; clockMovesNotMechanical allows only pending to overdue past its date

R9: the rows C-117.26 NO_SUBJECT (actions R62), and C-117.27 MACHINE_CANNOT_SET_PROCEEDING are held in ACTION_CATALOGUE_CHECKS, each {check, where, translation} exactly, in that order before T41's row, their wheres naming actions' minting sites; no other table holds them; their words name no op, ruling or check number

R9 (T45; K2845, K2859): the moved hold rows are retired once actions deleted its copy of the hold code (action-holds' C-149 holds them): C-117.17 PRESSURE_MARKED, .18 PRESSURE_NO_ENTRY, .20 MACHINE_CANNOT_SET_HOLD, .21 HOLD_REFUSED, .23 HOLD_RELEASE_IS_ITS_OWN_ACT, .24 HOLD_PROJECTS_REFUSED, .25 HOLD_ALREADY_RELEASED, and .22 HOLD_NO_LEGAL_MARK; no table holds the code or the number; negative control: the pressure rows actions still mints, C-117.14–.16, stay

R9: every row is held as before the move, number and translation unchanged; C-73.6's where names its new site, C-117.11's names contactNotAMember (K837); C-117.5 is action-clocks', not here; C-117.26–.58 and C-32.21 (R14) are added, C-117.17, .18, .20–.25 retired (T45); C-117.19's translation is the reason's alone (K2849 (4)); C-94.5's translation names none_exists (R13); since T46 twenty-four of C-117.30–.56 translate by words.json (R26)

R6, R8 (K899 (1)): text a member reads says record, never bundle: actionBasisFindings' target finding and respondsToEdgeFindings' repair are re-worded, and no row, finding, repair or reading over the corpus holds the word
R10: pure: deeply frozen inputs are read without change, and the same inputs give the same answers
R10: never throws on a document it cannot read; with nowMs given, the clock is not read
R11: no place is named in the module's outward text (rows, findings, readings over the whole corpus); the test profile's kinds are accepted and checked like any other

R12: every entity id the module tests (counterparty.entity_id, under every named kind, at the arm and in the audit) is tested by record-grammar's idPattern('ENT'): ENT-2026-10000 is accepted, ENT-2026-999 refused as before, and every finding on the corpus is byte-identical

R7 (K1444 (iii)): a pending clock entry is past its date only once the office's local day (ctx.zone, through civil-time) has ended; with no zone, an unknown zone or an unreadable time, no entry is past its date; every other C-11.1 and C-2.10 finding is unchanged

R7, R8, R9 (T34-87; DEC-149, K1811): a member reads "your group's Civicsmith", never "this instance" or "the plane": requestLifecycleOf's says (R8), C-2.10's kind finding (R7) and C-101.1 ACTION_KIND_UNKNOWN's translation (R9) are re-worded, and no row, finding, repair or reading over the corpus holds the old names
R13: CORRESPONDENCE_OUTCOMES gains none_exists, appended, every earlier outcome in its place (R2's one binding)

R13: none_exists is an outcome of a received decision as the others are (R5): on each decision stage it answers no lifecycle finding, the ledger arm and the audit are clean, and the read carries it; negative controls: on a sent entry it is OUTCOME_NOT_ON_RECEIVED, a near-miss is OUTCOME_NOT_IN_VOCABULARY naming none_exists, and a decision with no outcome is still DECISION_WITHOUT_OUTCOME
R13 (T51 fix round 10, R30): C-94.5's translation names the whole outcome vocabulary in plain words, none exists and none stated included

R13: seeksOf answers a records request's well-formed items, each once, in order, as {progression, entity, stage}; [] when absent; negative controls: malformed and repeated items are left out, another kind and a seeks that is not a list answer []

R13: seeksFindings pushes nothing for well-formed seeks whose every stage its progression declares, nor for an absent seeks on any kind; it answers nothing; negative control beside each: one fault, one finding
R13: seeks on another kind than records_request is one finding, and nothing more is asked of it; negative control: the same seeks on a records request is clean
R13: seeks that is not a list of 1 to 12 entries is one finding; more than 12 is one finding beside each item's own; negative controls: exactly 1 and exactly 12 are clean

R13: a malformed item is one finding each: not an entry, a key beyond the three, a part that is not a non-empty string of at most 200 characters; negative controls: 200 characters, and a part with inner spaces, are well formed
R13: an item repeating an earlier one is one finding each; negative controls: items differing in any one part are distinct

R13: an item whose stage facts says its progression does not declare is one finding, and one whose progression facts says is not held; negative controls: a declared stage is clean, and a progression facts names no entry for is not judged

R13: every finding is C-117.29 SEEKS_REFUSED's: the row is held in ACTION_CATALOGUE_CHECKS, its where names seeksFindings in this module, and its translation names no op, ruling, check number or place

R13, R10: seeksFindings and seeksOf read no record and change nothing: deeply frozen inputs, the same answers each time, never a throw on junk; the audit is not asked (actions R70 asks seeksFindings at its write)

R14: the row C-32.21 MACHINE_CANNOT_STATE_SEEKS is held in RECORDS_LAW_FENCE_CHECKS directly after C-32.20, {check, where, translation} exactly, its where naming actions' fence (#seeksFence > is-machine-state-seeks, actions R72), its words saying a machine or unstamped author may propose and may not state or change what a records request seeks; no other table holds it; negative controls: C-32.20 is unchanged and C-32.21 is held by no other code

R2 (T45): the new vocabularies are exported frozen, each its one binding with its values in order; PHRASING_KINDS is jurisdictions' own binding (its R86), never a copy; negative control: no earlier export moved (each earlier name still answers its value)

R5 (T45): the lifecycle grammar is the same for every kind, its stages keyed by direction: an acknowledgement on a request for comment's received entry is accepted, at the arm, the ledger arm and the audit; negative control: an acknowledgement on a sent entry still pushes STAGE_NOT_OF_DIRECTION

R8 (T45; K2849): the press arm accepts the reporter who holds the role, in the bytes the flat text holder: "<name>" (and as the reads present it, {name}), 1 to 200 characters with no quote, backslash or line break; a malformed holder, or a holder on any other arm, pushes one C-2.10 finding naming the arm holder; negative controls: a press counterparty with a holder pushes nothing, the same holder on an office pushes the finding, and every counterparty without a holder answers as before

R15: overrideGroundFindings accepts a legal_deadline {citation, date} and an irreversible_act {what, when}; with no ground, a ground not an object, or another kind, OVERRIDE_NO_GROUND naming both grounds; each part missing or malformed, or a key the kind lacks, OVERRIDE_GROUND_REFUSED naming the part; negative controls: each ground well formed pushes nothing, date 2026-02-30 is refused, no ground is OVERRIDE_NO_GROUND

R15 (K2849): premiseOverrideOf presents a premise_override's flat keys (reason, ground_kind, ground_citation, ground_date, ground_what, ground_when) as {reason, ground}, ground null for an override stating none (one written before T45); an override already presented is answered as given; overrideGroundFindings judges what it presents, and the audit reads the bytes through it; negative controls: a pre-T45 override reads ground null and is not reported, a flat legal deadline with 2026-02-30 is refused

R6 (T45; K2845, K2849 (5)): a rests_on leg may name a success record by consequences' id, SUC-<year>-<4 digits>, with no canonical-id finding (until record-grammar registers the prefix, N911); negative controls: the same id on an advances leg, a SUC id of another form, and any other unknown target are refused as before

R16: PHRASINGS is exported deeply frozen, per language and kind, English alone, each phrasing 2 to 100 characters on one line naming no place; every pinned phrasing is present in its kind; negative control: no kind's English list is empty and no other language is held

R17: phrasingsFor answers the product's phrasings, then the view's well-formed items whose locale applies (the whole tag case-insensitive, else its primary subtag) and whose kind is asked, each once, a profile phrasing equal to a product one answered once as product, a malformed item named in ignored; undetermined language_malformed, kind_unknown or no_list, never an empty read; negative controls: en with a view adding one phrasing answers both origins, es with no view is undetermined no_list, es with a view holding a Spanish phrasing is read

R18: pointOut answers every match in sentence order then position, with its offsets in the sentence as given, read in NFC, case-folded, typographic quotes plain and white space collapsed, a match bounded by no letter, mark or digit; a question is not exempt; undetermined not_sentences for anything but 0 to 5,000 strings of at most 10,000 characters, and R17's undetermined passes through; negative controls: the canon's five

R19: a resolution names the exact text of a pointed-out sentence with only_asks (and the member's words, 1 to 500 characters on one line) or breach_claim (no words); a resolution naming no pointed-out sentence, a second of one sentence, or a malformed one pushes ASSERTION_RESOLUTION_REFUSED naming the item; assertionsUnresolved answers the unresolved indexes and breach_claim, undetermined when pointed is; negative controls: only_asks with words resolves, without words is refused, an edited sentence is unresolved again, one breach_claim answers breach_claim: true

R20: copied, absent or 0 to 20 named addressees each checked as R8 checks a named counterparty (COUNTERPARTY_REFUSED naming copied[i]), never an audience or undetermined, none twice; the addressee's office COPIED_IS_ADDRESSEE; partners, absent or 0 to 20 {role, organisation, entity_id?}, any other key or a repeated organisation PARTNERS_REFUSED naming the entry; negative controls: a distinct copied office and a well-formed partner push nothing, the addressee's office copied is COPIED_IS_ADDRESSEE, {name: Jo Smith} is PARTNERS_REFUSED

R21: press_terms, absent or {on_record, embargo_until?, release_at?, note?}, on_record one of PRESS_RECORD_TERMS, the times local date-times with a real date, note at most 500 characters by R8's text rule; malformed or another key PRESS_TERMS_REFUSED; not on the press arm PRESS_TERMS_NOT_PRESS; negative controls: well-formed terms on a press action push nothing, on an office action PRESS_TERMS_NOT_PRESS

R22 (K2849): entryFieldFindings over the entry's flat keys: office_words (and office_status, the status token) only on a received entry carrying an outcome, office_words 1 to 500 characters with no quotation mark, backslash or line break (K2859), else OFFICE_STATUS_WITHOUT_OUTCOME; office_status one of facts.responseStatuses, else (or with none handed in) OFFICE_STATUS_UNKNOWN; found_elsewhere (a kind of FOUND_ELSEWHERE_KINDS) and found_elsewhere_note (at most 500 characters, none of those three) only on a received entry, else FOUND_ELSEWHERE_REFUSED, and with no artifact_sha FOUND_ELSEWHERE_NEEDS_CAPTURE; speaker only on a sent entry, a member id of 1 to 200 characters, else SPEAKER_REFUSED; negative controls: an entry with none of them pushes nothing, words with an outcome and a held status push nothing, without outcome are refused, found_elsewhere on sent and speaker on received are refused

R23 (K2859): reply_owed absent, true or false, else REPLY_OWED_REFUSED, and stated together with reply_owed_reason (1 to 500 characters with no quotation mark, backslash or line break), the reason never alone, else REPLY_OWED_REFUSED (the one site of that condition, actions R82 answering through it); follows_action absent or {action, ord?}, action an action's record id, ord a non-negative integer, else FOLLOWS_ACTION_REFUSED; equal to ctx.bundleId FOLLOWS_ACTION_SELF; negative controls: reply_owed false with a reason and a link to another action push nothing, reply_owed 'no', a reply_owed with no reason and a self-link push their codes

R24: bearingFindings: claims, 1 to 50 {claim, bearing, note?}, each claim one of the action's leg targets, none twice, a bearing of BEARINGS, a note of at most 500 characters; each fault BEARING_REFUSED naming the item; negative controls: one claim per leg with a listed bearing pushes nothing, a claim not among the legs is refused

R25: lawStagesFindings reports one LAW_STAGE_UNKNOWN per item whose stage is not a records-request stage of either direction, [] for a well-formed list; stageInLaw answers in_law, not_in_law, or undetermined when the stages are not a list, never in_law for a stage lawStagesFindings reports; negative controls: a list without fee_waiver_request answers not_in_law for it and in_law for appeal, no list undetermined, {stage: mediation} reported

R7 (T45): the audit also reports the override's ground (only for a premise_override stating one, read from its flat keys), the press holder, copied and partners, press terms, each entry's new fields (no facts handed: words and outcome only), reply_owed and follows_action (with ctx.bundleId), and C-11.1's owed_by arm; negative controls: owed_by us is reported, group and none are not; an override written before T45 with no ground is not reported; the corpus written before T45 is unchanged (grammar.test.mjs, R7)

R9 (T45; K2845, K2849): the rows C-117.30–.58 are held in ACTION_CATALOGUE_CHECKS after C-117.29, in R9's order, each {check, where, translation} exactly; the codes actions mints (its R8, R74, R77–R88, its copied fence) name actions' sites, as its job names them, and those action-records now raises its sites (R28); the shape codes this module's arms push name the arm that pushes them; action-holds' and action-replies' codes are no C-117 row (C-149, C-150), BEARING_REFUSED among them; no translation names an op, ruling, check number, record id or place; negative control: no other table holds them

R11 (T45): the phrasing lists name no place, office or person; the test profile extends them with a phrasing per kind in English, and a second test profile in a second language does the same: a text in that language is undetermined with no profile's phrasings and pointed out with them; the English test-profile phrasings are pointed out only with the profile
R10 (T45): every T45 function is pure: deeply frozen inputs are read without change, the same inputs give the same answers, and none throws on junk

R26: ACTION_GRAMMAR_WORDS is frozen and holds exactly the twenty-four rows' keys, refusal.<CODE>, each words.json's en verbatim; each of those rows reads its translation from it by key, never a copy; codes, numbers and wheres unmoved; T45's words answered no longer

R26: C-117.32 OVERRIDE_GROUND_REFUSED, C-117.41 OFFICE_STATUS_WITHOUT_OUTCOME, C-117.55 REPLY_OWED_REFUSED and C-117.57 LAW_STAGE_UNKNOWN keep their T45 translations, not words.json's (each sentence and its requirement do not yet agree); C-117.58 MACHINE_CANNOT_SET_COPIED, which words.json does not hold, keeps its own; BEARING_REFUSED is no row here and its sentence is not taken; negative control: each kept row's words.json sentence differs from what the row reads

R26: each code this module's arms push is answered through its row with the T46 words (the taken rows words.json's, the kept rows T45's), its finding unmoved in check, severity, message and code; negative controls: the same arm over a well-formed input pushes nothing
